Did you know?

Logistic Regression starts with a weighted sum and a sigmoid. Rather than only calling a library function, we unpack what the model is actually computing.

z = w₁x₁ + w₂x₂ + ··· + b
prediction = sigmoid(z) We unpack every model like this.

Course Roadmap

12 Topics — From Fundamentals to Advanced Applications
Topic 1

Introduction to Machine Learning

What is ML? Types, workflow, evaluation, e.g., KNN

Topic 2

Traditional Machine Learning Models

e.g., Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, KNN, Decision Trees

Topic 3

Ensemble Learning

e.g., Random Forest, Boosting, XGBoost

Topic 4

Deep Learning Fundamentals

Neural Networks from Scratch

Topic 5

Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs)

Image data, architectures, applications

Topic 6

Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs, LSTM, GRU)

Sequential data, time series, NLP basics

Topic 7

Transformers & Large Language Models (LLMs)

Attention, Transformer architecture, LLMs

Topic 8

Autoencoders & Variational Autoencoders

Representation learning, generative models

Topic 9

Transfer Learning and Generative AI

Pre-trained models, diffusion models

Topic 10

Few-Shot Learning

Learning with limited data

Topic 11

Active Learning

Efficient data annotation and model training

Topic 12

Reinforcement Learning

Basics, key algorithms, applications

◎

Model Evaluation & Explainable AI

Integrated module: metrics, visualization, and model interpretation.
